honest_summary.answer: 100 classes at 200-500 images each is NOT established as supportable. 17 proposed classes meet a preliminary 150-file CATEGORY-COUNT threshold; this does not establish they contain 150 unique, usable, correctly labelled, appropriately licensed images. 56 reach 50 category files; 9 reach 200. All figures are sums of direct category-file counts excluding subcategories, they are non-additive because categories overlap, and none is licence-verified. 40-60 classes is a preliminary development target, not an established result: feasibility depends on image-level licence verification, image quality review, deduplication and subcategory expansion, none of which has been performed. Subcategory expansion is an unmeasured opportunity, not confirmed volume.

source.access: API reachable via out-of-sandbox tooling; image hosts (upload.wikimedia.org) BLOCKED from sandbox
source.share_alike_caveat: CC BY-SA is share-alike on the image; effect on trained model weights is legally unsettled

known_gaps: images not downloadable from the sandbox - the biggest unknown

bucket_definitions.A_preliminary_threshold_met: ≥150 direct category files. Meets a preliminary count threshold only; NOT training-ready and NOT verified as usable.
bucket_definitions.B_possible: 50–149 direct category files. Possible but likely thin for a three-way split.
bucket_definitions.C_marginal: 1–49 direct category files. Too few to plan around.
bucket_definitions.D_unmeasured: Commons category not identified/verified; count is 0 and means unknown, not absent.

count_semantics: verified_direct_files = number of files Commons reports directly in the category (API prop=categoryinfo). Subcategory contents are excluded. Categories overlap, so these values are NOT additive and the corpus total is NOT a unique-image count. These are counts of file pages, not of verified usable photographs, and they are not licence-filtered.
unverified_estimates: ~50 classes retaining ≥100 images is a projection, not a measurement.
40-60 classes being achievable is a preliminary target contingent on four unperformed checks.
10-20% additional loss from dedupe + contamination filtering is assumed, not measured on Commons.
The only measured dedupe loss (13.15%, 4000->3474) comes from the unrelated 80-class V2 audit set.
licence_verified_scope: false for all 100 classes: per-file licence distribution not enumerated.
